questions.question_text: Any actual or potential conflict of interest relating to this RFP must be disclosed.
Please provide a profile of your organization, including years in business, number of employees and head office location.
Please describe your approach to social procurement, including Indigenous, local and diversity-owned subcontracting.
Three client references for comparable projects are to be provided using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The Proponent shall describe at least two comparable projects completed in the last five years, including scope, duration and outcome.
The Proponent must confirm that the fleet telematics platform conforms to WCAG 2.1 Level AA (Yes/No).
The fleet telematics platform must keep an audit log of user activity that administrators cannot alter (Yes/No).
Please describe the licensing model (named user, concurrent or enterprise) and how licence counts are measured.
The Proponent shall describe how GPS devices will be installed in approximately 450 vehicles with minimal downtime.
(Optional) Please describe how driver behaviour (harsh braking, speeding, idling) is scored and how a driver can dispute a score.
The fleet telematics platform must integrate with the fuel card provider used by the City (Yes/No).
The Proponent shall describe how location data is buffered when a vehicle is outside cellular coverage.
The Proponent should attach sample maintenance alert reports generated from engine diagnostic codes.
The Proponent must describe its disaster recovery plan, including recovery time and recovery point objectives.
The Proponent must confirm that the fleet telematics platform will achieve monthly availability of at least 99.9 percent (Yes/No).
The Proponent shall describe how it complies with the Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act (Alberta) and any other privacy legislation that applies to vehicle and driver data.
The Proponent shall state whether it holds a current ISO/IEC 27001 certification (Yes/No).
Describe how administrative access to production systems is controlled and logged.
Describe how security events are monitored and who responds outside business hours.
State whether penetration testing is performed by an independent party. (Yes/No)
The Proponent shall describe the exit and transition assistance available at the end of the contract.
The Proponent must describe its support model, including hours of coverage, escalation paths and target response times.
The Proponent shall state the proposed implementation timeline from contract award to go-live.
Please identify the five most significant project risks and the mitigation proposed for each.
The Proponent must describe its testing approach, including user acceptance testing and who signs off.
The Proponent shall describe the warranty provided and what it excludes.
Provide a high-level schedule showing the main phases and their durations.
Identify the tasks that need the participation of staff of the City.
Describe how scope changes will be handled during implementation.
Attach a sample status report from a comparable project.
(Optional) Details of the training provided to administrators and end users, including delivery method, duration and materials, are to be included.
(Optional) Please describe your project management methodology and how progress will be reported to the City.
The Proponent should describe the integration options, such as APIs and file transfer, available between the fleet telematics platform and the existing systems of the City.
A current Workers' Compensation Board clearance letter must be provided with the Proposal.
The most recent SOC 2 Type II report is to be attached.
The Proponent must attach a certificate of insurance showing commercial general liability coverage of not less than $5,000,000.
questions.constraints: commercial general liability of not less than $5,000,000

questions.question_text: The Proponent must provide hourly rates by role for change requests and additional services.
The Proponent must confirm that its prices will be held for 120 days after the Closing Time (Yes/No).
The Proponent shall state every assumption and exclusion that affects the prices quoted.
Pricing is to be submitted using the Pricing Schedule in Appendix C, in Canadian dollars and excluding GST.
questions.constraints: Appendix C; Canadian dollars, excluding GST

questions.question_text: The fleet telematics platform shall mask personal information in non-production environments.
The fleet telematics platform shall allow documents of up to 100 MB to be attached to a record.
The fleet telematics platform shall allow all data to be extracted in a documented, non-proprietary format at any time.
The fleet telematics platform shall support retention rules that can be set by record type.
The fleet telematics platform shall provide a test environment for trying upgrades before they reach production.
The fleet telematics platform should support electronic signatures that are legally binding in Alberta.
The Proponent must describe its disaster recovery plan, including recovery time and recovery point objectives.
The Proponent shall provide three client references for comparable projects using the table in Appendix B.
questions.constraints: three references, table in Appendix B

questions.question_text: The Proponent should describe its project management methodology and how progress will be reported to the City.
